name: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior who relies on raw emotion and physical prowess in combat.

features.name: Rage
features.description: Enter a battle frenzy granting damage resistance and bonus damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: AC equals 10 + Dex + Con while not wearing armor.

name: Bard
description: An inspiring magician whose words and music heal hearts and stir emotions.
skills: Choose 3 from: Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Religion, Sleight of Hand, Stealth

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Grant inspiration dice to allies to add to rolls.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half proficiency bonus to ability checks.

name: Cleric
description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a domain granting domain spells and features.

features.name: Turn Undead
features.description: Channel energy to turn undead creatures.

name: Druid
description: A priest of the old faith, guardian of the wild places of the world.
skills: Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Persuasion, Religion, Survival

features.name: Druidic
features.description: Know Druidic language and cannot be affected by wild shape confusion.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Transform into a beast form.

name: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a wide variety of weapons and armor.
skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, Survival

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a combat style granting a special benefit.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take an additional action on your turn.

name: Monk
description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of body and mind.
skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Stealth, Religion

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: AC equals 10 + Dex + Wis while unarmored.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Spend ki points to supercharge abilities.

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.description: Make two extra attacks after a martial arts attack.

name: Paladin
description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath, dedicated to vanquishing evil.
skills: Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, Religion

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: Detect celestial, fiendish, or undead presence.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Heal with a touch equal to paladin level × 5.

name: Ranger
description: A master of wilderness survival and ranged combat, hunting the enemies of civilization.
skills: Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, Survival

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Study a specific enemy type for bonuses against them.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Travel through favored terrain without slowing.

name: Rogue
description: A slippery scoundrel who uses stealth and cunning to achieve their goals.
skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, Stealth

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Deal extra damage when you have advantage or an ally is adjacent.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

name: Sorcerer
description: A caster who wields innate magic drawn from their bloodline.
skills: Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Religion

features.name: Sorcery Points
features.description: Spend points to modify spells with metamagic.

features.name: Meta magic
features.description: Twin or extend spells using sorcery points.

name: Warlock
description: A wielder of magic granted by a pact with an otherworldly patron.
skills: Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature, Religion

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Cast spells using warlock spell slots.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Learn magical eldritch invocations.

name: Wizard
description: A scholarly arcane spellcaster who masters magic through study.
skills: Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, Religion

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Recover spell slots on a short rest.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.description: Choose a school granting special features.
